proof_summary: A finite modular computation shows the alternating harmonic sum through 1092 is congruent to zero modulo 1093; splitting the sum through \(1093^2-1\) into multiples and nonmultiples of 1093 then proves its reduced denominator is coprime to \(1093^2\). Applying the auxiliary sum recurrence and elementary gcd identities gives \(a(1093^2-1)=1\), although \(1093^2\) is composite.
